department_index.camera: b1 low wide camera (about 0.9 m high, 24 mm) then b2 chest-height medium; b3 low close push for the payoff
department_index.set: b1_a/b1_b: wooden Western street, false-front shops leading to a vanishing point, telegraph poles, packed sand; the same noon street for every beat
department_index.light: b1-b3: hard noon sun from the upper left, saturated blue sky with white clouds, warm sand, long soft contact shadows
department_index.character: b2_a/b2_b: one hat-wearing hero as the only figure, hat brim reads at phone size, face calm and deadpan
department_index.prop: b3_a: a small prop high in the sky as the payoff object (here: the coin); b1_a left-foreground wood structures give depth (here: a water trough)
department_index.color: cool blue sky against warm orange sand and red/brown shop fronts; one accent colour on the hero
department_index.animator: b2: stillness, then a small sharp action; b3: reaction held for a beat
department_index.vfx: b3_a: small dust motes and a glint on the moving object
